model.description: R32.3: the MDA model tree renders over the SHARED rb-trace-tree (no fork - data + forward-key config only, R31.3/R31.11 law). The server shapes each model node's display type from its M2 MODEL-facet instanceOf via server.modelFacetType (UmlClass/UmlInterface/UmlAttribute/UmlMethod/UmlProperty/UmlFunction) so rb-object-item picks the right icon; children walk = ModelElement `members` composition (chain-model additive forward-key entry, forwardKeysForMode R31.11); badge = members.length (childRefCount stamp REUSE); relatesTo is NOT a child (detail/R32.6). Re-parse = same UUIDs (R32.2) -> stable tree; /trace + Server Manager + room trees UNREGRESSED (additive). Primary Impl anchor = the named server.modelFacetType decl (the /api/model/tree route is inline endpoint glue). The R32.3 Test (tester independent vitest) asserts the 8 finalized ACs incl the shared-tree no-regression check.
